texts: The statement is true: complex congenital heart disease has been the most common indication for heart transplantation in infants under 12 months.
Many of these infants have hypoplastic left heart syndrome or other single-ventricle or complex lesions, either instead of staged palliation or after it has failed.
In older children, cardiomyopathy becomes the leading indication.
In the picture, most of the babies queuing at the gardener's flowerpots carry wrongly built hotels.
Memory hook: under one candle, a wrongly built hotel is the commonest reason for a new one.
